# Pirate Arcade

Pirate Arcade is a pirate-themed arcade game collection by Erich Donahue. It includes desktop Python/Pygame games, browser ports built with Pygbag/WebAssembly, a web-native Phaser 3 game, and a public build log documenting a zero-cost AI-assisted development experiment.

## Main pages

- Home: https://pirate-arcade.com/
- Play: https://pirate-arcade.com/play/
- Build Log: https://pirate-arcade.com/build-log/
- About: https://pirate-arcade.com/about/
- Source: https://pirate-arcade.com/source/

## Games

Total: 5 games — 4 browser-playable (3 Pygbag/WebAssembly ports, 1 web-native Phaser 3 racer), 1 desktop-only (Port Royale Tycoon).

- Cannonball Clash: naval Pong-style duel, Pygbag/WebAssembly browser port at https://pirate-arcade.com/play/cannonball-clash/
- Treasure Cove: pirate Breakout-style brick breaker, Pygbag/WebAssembly browser port at https://pirate-arcade.com/play/treasure-cove/
- Kraken's Wake: pirate Asteroids-style game, Pygbag/WebAssembly browser port at https://pirate-arcade.com/play/krakens-wake/
- Race to Treasure Island: top-down pirate ship racer, web-native Phaser 3 at https://pirate-arcade.com/play/race-to-treasure-island/
- Port Royale Tycoon: pirate property-trading desktop game (desktop-only).
